latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Video Editor Gameplay.

- Instantly edits and exports gameplay videos by describing your desired changes.
- Accepts MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB; renders server-side in 1–2 minutes.
- Automated highlight detection, transitions, and beat syncing—no prior editing knowledge required.
- Cloud-based processing with auto token/session setup; 100 free credits for new users.
- Simple text commands to cut, add music, export, check credits, and preview clips.
